The test image is a microscopic view (50 μm scale bar) showing:
- A dark brown central mass (likely a sporulating body/acervulus)
- Multiple radiating septate conidiophores
- Oval/elliptical conidia at tips, some with visible internal septation
- Credit: Bruce Watt, Bugwood #5505971

This microscopy morphology points toward a fungal pathogen producing oval multicellular conidia. Top candidates: **Early_Blight** (Alternaria solani), **Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers**, **Leaf_Mold**, or **Anthracnose**.

Now I'll view one reference from each top candidate class.

This reference (Bugwood_14, credit: Bruce Watt, 50.0 μm scale) is an extremely strong match to the test image:
- Same photographer, same scale bar, sequential Bugwood IDs (5505966 vs 5505971)
- Identical oval/elliptical muriform conidia with grid-like internal septation
- Same golden-brown color and morphology

This is almost certainly **Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers**. Let me use my final reference view on another class.

Septoria shows field-level circular spots on leaves - entirely different from the microscopic fungal structures in the test image.

**Summary of evidence:**

| Reference | Match to test image |
|---|---|
| Early_Blight/CDDM_1107 | Field symptom illustration, no match |
| Alternaria/Bugwood_4 | Stem canker field view, no match |
| Alternaria/Bugwood_13 | Microscopic Alternaria conidia - morphology similar direction |
| Leaf_Mold/CDDM_313 | Field leaf symptom, no match |
| Anthracnose/Bugwood_13 | Pepper fruit lesion, no match |
| Anthracnose/Bugwood_4 | Thin cylindrical Colletotrichum conidia - different shape |
| **Alternaria/Bugwood_14** | **Microscopic, same photographer (Bruce Watt), same 50 μm scale, sequential Bugwood IDs (5505966 vs 5505971), identical oval muriform conidia - STRONG MATCH** |
| Septoria/CDDM_1928 | Field leaf spots, no match |

The test image shows Alternaria-type conidia being produced from a conidiophore cluster, with the characteristic oval multicellular (muriform) conidia with both transverse and longitudinal septa. The reference Bugwood_14 from Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers is essentially the same preparation by the same photographer.
